Name: Pithon
Summary: Son of Micah, named among the sons of Micah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:35; 1 Chronicles 9:41: Son of Micah, named among the sons of Micah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Pithon stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
